context: A nutritionist explains a healthy budget meal plan
purpose: Teach: たんぱく/物価/不景気/危険性/ハンドル/急速/細かい/アクセス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 先生、不景気で物価も上がって、健康的な食事が続けられるか不安なんです。
lines.en: Doctor, with the recession and prices rising, I'm worried I can't keep eating healthily.
lines.style: soft anxious tone, trailing slightly at the end

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: わかります。でも工夫すれば大丈夫ですよ。まず一日のたんぱく質をきちんと確保しましょう。
lines.en: I understand. But with some planning it's fine. First, let's secure enough protein each day.
lines.style: calm reassuring professional tone with steady pacing

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: たんぱく源って、お肉ばかりだと高くつきますよね…。
lines.en: Protein sources get expensive if it's all meat, right?
lines.style: hesitant questioning lilt, slightly worried voice

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 卵や豆腐、納豆を上手に使えば、食費を大幅に抑えられますよ。安い旬の野菜にもアクセスしやすい時期です。
lines.en: Eggs, tofu, and natto used wisely can significantly cut food costs. Cheap seasonal vegetables are also easy to access right now.
lines.style: informative steady tone, practical and encouraging delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 細かい栄養バランスまで考えるのは難しそうです…。
lines.en: Thinking about the detailed nutritional balance sounds difficult...
lines.style: soft sigh, gentle uncertainty in voice

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 食生活のハンドルをしっかり握れば、体は急速に整っていきますよ。極端な食事制限には危険性がありますからね。
lines.en: If you firmly grip the wheel of your diet, your body will rapidly come back into balance. Extreme dieting carries real risks, you know.
lines.style: warm authoritative tone with steady measured delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 危険性があるんですか?無理なダイエットはやめた方がいいですね。
lines.en: There are risks? I should stop doing extreme diets then.
lines.style: slightly surprised, reflective realization in tone

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ。週に一度、買い物リストを一緒に確認しましょう。続けることが何より大切ですよ。
lines.en: Yes. Once a week, let's review your shopping list together. Consistency matters more than anything.
lines.style: kind closing tone, supportive and steady
